# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

Siemens Xcelerator

energy transition.

[Learn more][31]

## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Nuclear Energy - Powering a
## Sustainable & Clean Future

Only company associated with all three stages of Indian Nuclear Power Programme

## Technology Innovations
## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

We are actively working on renewable energy, energy efficient systems and low emission technologies

## Equipping
## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

Regular supplier of Super Rapid Gun Mount Naval Guns for providing Anti-Shipping and Anti-Air
capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

of products and services with over 180 product offerings to meet the ever-growing needs of the core
sectors of economy.

### Frequently Asked Questions

Is CET Technology a small or big company?

CET Technology is a small business that has a big range of product offerings.
We make different type of transformers, inductors, DC to DC converters and power supplies.

Where does CET Technology manufacture?

CET Technology manufactures in both China and Vietnam. We can drop ship the products to worldwide

the ability, if
requested, to modify or custom make parts for our customers.

Does CET accept blanket orders?

down on lead time

Lead times for parts is an issue with my current vendor, can you do better?

Our initial cold start lead time is similar to others but after the first shipment we will stock
your yearly usage
in our New Hampshire facility with a blanket order in place, which means the lead time on future
shipments is only
days instead of weeks or months.

What kind of support do you offer for your parts?

We offer stateside engineering, sales and customer service. You are a phone call or an email away
from getting any
and all the help you may need.

Some of the places we deal with require large MOQ’s and payment up front, do you require this as

No….our MOQ on most parts is often as low as 100pcs and we only invoice when we ship.

After you complete my design, how much will I pay for samples to test?

Often you will pay nothing! Unless your design requires expensive materials and/or is large in size,
we often can offer up to 5 samples free of charge. We are not looking to profit off samples.

# Useful Cannabis Seed Strain Guide

There are countless cannabis seed varieties. There are so many cannabis varieties that nobody can
establish an exact count, as more are being bred. This is because the varieties are bred with each
other. Meanwhile you get every questionable cannabis seed variety available, but they are all based
on the same plant, the Cannabis Sativa. Cannabis varieties can vary in effect, price, cultivation,
appearance and other elements. Some of the most famous cannabis seed strains are certainly Crystal,
Chronic, Big Bud, Ice, White Widow, Northern Light and Super Skunk. But there are numerous other
cannabis seed varieties than only these.

Cannabis varieties can be split into four main groups/species. These are:
* Indica
* Cannabis Sativa
* Cannabis Ruderalis

## Indica Cannabis

Indica cannabis strains are typically small and dense. Well suited for the so-called "Homegrow",
where you grow hemp at home in your growbox. Despite the fact that the plant becomes relatively
small (about 1m), Indicas produce relatively many buds. There are Indica Cannabis varieties that
yield up to 600g per m² (about 4-5 plants). Indicas almost all come from Afghanistan, Pakistan,
India, Tibet, Nepal, etc. so mainly from South Asia. The effect is more physical and makes you
stoned, creating deep relaxation.

## Cannabis Sativa

Sativa comes from the equatorial regions. This variety continues growing during flowering, so
Sativas tend to grow very tall. In nature, these can grow up to many meters high. The leaves are
broad with many small leaflets.

## Cannabis Ruderalis

The name comes from "ruderal", a term for a wild growing plant. Ruderalis is indigenous to Russia,
Central Europe and Central Asia. They are very small, between 30-80 cm tall. The plant has very few
branches, but broad, bushy and light green fingers. As it has very low THC content, it is rarely
smoked but its genetics makes it very interesting for crossing.

2026-07-20

Our wireless charging coils ,offer reliable, high-efficiency power transfer across a wide range of
applications—from wearables and smartphones to automotive and industrial devices. Available in
both transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) configurations, our coils support Qi (WPC
1.3) and AirFuel standards. Key design features include ferrite shielding for stable EMI
performance, multi-turn planar structures, and customizable inductance (±3%), DCR, and form factor
(round, square, or elliptical).

## About Us

Kexun Electric Co., Ltd.

[**Kexun Electric Co., Ltd.**][91] is located in Yueqing City, Zhejiang Province, the well-known
"Electrical Capital of China", with the East China Sea and the Oujiang River in the south and
Yandang Mountain, a national scenic spot, in the north. The company was founded in 2010 with a
registered capital of 150 million yuan.

The company is a scientific and technological enterprise specializing in the research, production,
sales and service of power transmission and transformation equipment of 35KV and below. The main
products are: high-voltage inflatable cabinets, high voltage ring main unit, [**cable branch
box,**][92] cable distribution boxes, [**box-type substations**][93], power transformers,
high-voltage and low-voltage switchgear, SF6 ring main unit, central cabinets, meter boxes, SF6
high-voltage load switches, high-voltage components and so on.

## About Us

Kexun Electric Co., Ltd.

[**Kexun Electric Co., Ltd.**][91] is located in Yueqing City, Zhejiang Province, the well-known
"Electrical Capital of China", with the East China Sea and the Oujiang River in the south and
Yandang Mountain, a national scenic spot, in the north. The company was founded in 2010 with a
registered capital of 150 million yuan.

The company is a scientific and technological enterprise specializing in the research, production,
sales and service of power transmission and transformation equipment of 35KV and below. The main
products are: high-voltage inflatable cabinets, high voltage ring main unit, [**cable branch
box,**][92] cable distribution boxes, [**box-type substations**][93], power transformers,
high-voltage and low-voltage switchgear, SF6 ring main unit, central cabinets, meter boxes, SF6
high-voltage load switches, high-voltage components and so on.

Makpower repairs, refurbishes, and upgrades industrial transformers to restore dependable
performance and extend useful service life. Our work covers rewinding, cooling arrangement
improvement, rating enhancement, overhaul, and winding replacement for units that need practical
restoration rather than full replacement.

Makpower supports service and maintenance needs with essential transformer parts, replacement
components, and consumables required for smooth upkeep and repair work. This service helps plants
respond faster when wear, damage, or servicing requirements create pressure on continuity.

coordination, and maintenance requirements with better confidence. Our team also supports customers
with practical guidance during repair planning, troubleshooting, and service-related decision
making.

their extended tilespan and optimized performance Whether it's restoring aging transformers,

assess nach unit, conducting detalled inspections and tests to identify inefficiencies. With a
commitment to relistility, our service ensures minimal downtime and improved operational efficiency,

Faq's

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What types of transformers does Makpower manufacture?

Makpower manufactures a wide range of industrial transformers, including arc furnace transformers,
induction melting furnace transformers, power transformers, generator transformers, auxiliary
transformers, and BIS-marked distribution transformers. The company also manufactures industrial
electrical panel boards for industrial power applications.

## Does Makpower support customised transformer requirements?

Yes. Makpower supports transformer requirements based on application, power rating, voltage class,
and operating conditions. This makes the company suitable for industrial buyers who need equipment
shaped around plant duty rather than standard supply alone.

## What is Makpower’s manufacturing capacity?

Makpower currently offers transformers for power ratings up to 50 MVA and voltage class up to 132
KV, along with installation work for voltage class up to 11 KV. This allows the company to serve a
wide range of industrial and utility-linked requirements.

## Does Makpower provide repair and refurbishment services?

Yes. Makpower carries out repair, refurbishment, overhaul, rewinding, cooling arrangement
improvement, and rating enhancement work for transformers. The company also handles furnace
transformer repairs and supports suitable standby transformer requirements for customers who need
continuity during service work.


[Makpower][54] delivers transformer manufacturing, repair, and support for industries that depend on
steady power performance. Our work stays focused on reliability, sound engineering, and product
quality that holds up in real operating conditions.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What types of transformers does Makpower manufacture?

Makpower manufactures a wide range of industrial transformers, including arc furnace transformers,
induction melting furnace transformers, power transformers, generator transformers, auxiliary
transformers, and BIS-marked distribution transformers. The company also manufactures industrial
electrical panel boards for industrial power applications.

## Does Makpower support customised transformer requirements?

Yes. Makpower supports transformer requirements based on application, power rating, voltage class,
and operating conditions. This makes the company suitable for industrial buyers who need equipment
shaped around plant duty rather than standard supply alone.

## What is Makpower’s manufacturing capacity?

Makpower currently offers transformers for power ratings up to 50 MVA and voltage class up to 132
KV, along with installation work for voltage class up to 11 KV. This allows the company to serve a
wide range of industrial and utility-linked requirements.

## Does Makpower provide repair and refurbishment services?

Yes. Makpower carries out repair, refurbishment, overhaul, rewinding, cooling arrangement
improvement, and rating enhancement work for transformers. The company also handles furnace
transformer repairs and supports suitable standby transformer requirements for customers who need
continuity during service work.

steady power performance. Our work stays focused on reliability, sound engineering, and product
quality that holds up in real operating conditions.

# [who we are][26]

## [About industry][27]

Mingxing Electronic (Dongguan) Co., Ltd. was established in August 1998 and located in Xia Yicun
Industrial Park, Shijie Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China. We are a manufacturer of
metal stamping products and electronic components, specializing in producing metal product or
hardware for high & Low frequency transformer and in producing insulating material for transformer
and electronic appliance. Our products are widely used in modern telecommunication equipment and
home electronic appliance.

 Before you disclose to us the personal information of another person, you must obtain that person’s

the terms of this privacy policy.

**2. Cookies**
A cookie is a file containing an identifier (a string of letters and numbers) that is sent by a web
server to a web browser and is stored by the browser. The identifier is then sent back to the server
each time the browser requests a page from the server. This enables the web server to identify and
track the web browser.
We may use both “session” cookies and “persistent” cookies on the website. Session cookies will be
deleted from your computer when you close your browser. Persistent cookies will remain stored on
your computer until deleted, or until they reach a specified expiry date.
 We will use the session cookies to: keep track of you whilst you navigate the website; keep track

**2. Cookies**
A cookie is a file containing an identifier (a string of letters and numbers) that is sent by a web
server to a web browser and is stored by the browser. The identifier is then sent back to the server
each time the browser requests a page from the server. This enables the web server to identify and
track the web browser.
We may use both “session” cookies and “persistent” cookies on the website. Session cookies will be
deleted from your computer when you close your browser. Persistent cookies will remain stored on
your computer until deleted, or until they reach a specified expiry date.

## For When It Matters

***The Right Design, at the Right Time, at the Optimal Cost.***

At Standex Electronics, we deliver engineered solutions that perform when it matters most. As an
extension of our customers’ engineering teams, we collaborate closely to turn complex challenges
into elegant, manufacturable designs. Our approach combines precision performance with craftsmanship
where engineering meets aesthetics and every component reflects quality and reliability.

[Play Video][59]

## Precision Switching and Sensing Technologies That Power a Smarter, Safer World

From reed switches to sensors and relays, Standex Detect delivers precision-engineered solutions
trusted across automotive, industrial, and test applications. Discover how we enable smarter systems
through innovation in switches, sensors, and relays.

[Explore Standex Detect][60]

## Powering Progress Through Custom Magnetics

Standex Edge delivers precision-engineered magnetics that drive performance and reliability across
demanding applications. From planar transformers to inductors and chokes, our solutions empower
innovation in automotive, aerospace, industrial, and energy systems worldwide.

[Explore Standex Edge][61]

## Powering a Connected, Electrified Future

Standex Grid delivers precision-engineered transformer solutions that support energy infrastructure
and utility applications worldwide. Backed by decades of innovation from Amran and Narayan
Powertech, our products ensure reliable performance across mission-critical power systems.

[Explore Standex Grid][62]

## Global partner in precision-engineered electronic components

Precision sensor, relay, and reed switch solutions designed for automation, transportation, test and
measurement, and energy applications.

[Visit Standex Detect][63]

Custom magnetic components including transformers, inductors, and EMI components engineered for
power conversion across industrial, medical, military and aerospace markets.

[Visit Standex Edge][64]

High-voltage and instrument transformer solutions supporting grid reliability, modernization, and
efficient power delivery for global energy systems.

manufacturing of Transmission and Distribution (T&D) products. With a strong commitment to
sustainability and a net-zero vision, Voltamp Energy is at the forefront of the energy transition,
striving to provide reliable and efficient power solutions to the GCC region and beyond. The company
has gained recognition for being the largest power transformer manufacturer in the Gulf Cooperation
Council (GCC) region, capable of manufacturing transformers up to 400kV, 500VA ratings locally in
Oman.

Oman.

### Leader in Power Transformers

Voltamp was established in 1987 with a vision of developing capabilities for electrical products and
contributes towards the growth of power sector in Middle east region and North Africa (MENA). The
journey started as a LV switchgear franchisee panel builder for Schneider – France and in 1993
joined technical collaboration with Babcock – UK for distribution transformer and then in 2008
partnered with Tatung – Taiwan for power transformers.
